description: Look up a firm in ESMA's Union Register of investment firms (the EU-wide MiFID II authorisation register) by entity name (matches if every word appears anywhere in the name, order-independent) or LEI (exact match). Returns each matching entity's authorisation status (Active/Inactive), competent authority, home member state and entity type (investment firm, credit institution, etc.) — answers 'is this entity authorised to provide investment services in the EU'. Distinct from FIRDS: this is the firm register, not the instrument register.

lei.description: 20-character LEI, exact match. Used only if name is not given.

name.description: Entity name; every word must appear in the name, e.g. "Deutsche Bank".

name: esma_check_firm_authorisation
title: Esma Check Firm Authorisation
